subject: data and stan program for gravitational waves

messages.author: 49e107cb0f8a3d27
messages.subject: data and stan program for gravitational waves
parts:
Hi all,

Who should we contact to ask for the corresponding Stan programs and PyStan scripts they used?

It would be incredible to have a version of it, e.g., in the case studies page http://mc-stan.org/documentation/case-studies.html. The data (https://losc.ligo.org/events/GW150914/) is fairly manageable at 500MB, so we can throw all sorts of inference algorithms at it and use it to benchmark things.

Dustin
